guide_line: Turn a percent composition into a formula.
steps: Treat each percent as grams of that element.
Divide each mass by its atomic mass. Those are moles.
Divide every mole value by the smallest one.
If a ratio is about 1.5 or 1.33, multiply all of them until they are whole numbers.
Molecular formula = empirical formula × (molar mass / empirical mass). Type symbols, like CH2O.
